title: The Brothers' War Retro Artifacts: card flavor text

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Speaker who warns that victims will beg for madness.

entities.name: Ashnod
entities.description: Artificer whose grisly research notes and designs speak of dissection, blood fluting and liquimetal experiments.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Artificer who learns from nature, proposes overseers and writes to Harbin.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Planeswalker who wields the Blackblade and earns honors on a path to redemption.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Artificer who hopes to atone for his failures and thinks of building angels from a mundane power source.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Who once bottled the sky one night and released it the next.

entities.name: Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite
entities.description: Phyrexian leader who speaks of a glorious infection and of skin that is not their own.

entities.name: Noboru
entities.description: Master kitemaker.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: Tazeem lullmage who describes how a golem warps the Aether.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Rimewind master who praises Phyrexian technology and scorns Arcum.

entities.name: Arcum
entities.description: Person Heidar calls a babbling fool.

entities.name: Muzzio
entities.description: Artificer of Paliano who takes pupils.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Spirit dragon planeswalker who arranged the hedrons of Zendikar.

entities.name: Kara Vrist
entities.description: Neurok agent.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: Planeswalker who speaks of creation being inviolate and whose journal mentions partisans and an artifact.

entities.name: Rhmir
entities.description: Hand of the Augur.

entities.name: Glissa Sunseeker
entities.description: Speaker who asks what remains to be saved if the titan is defeated.

entities.name: Kenjek
entities.description: Captain of the Thousand Swords.

entities.name: Thousand Swords
entities.description: Company captained by Kenjek.

entities.name: Artonac
entities.description: Priest of Gix whose dreams brought visions of an altar.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Yawgmoth praetor and master of Artonac who gives a schematic to the younger brother.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother of Urza who scorns superstition and is given a schematic by Gix.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Artificer and lord whose diary and notes appear and who turned toward worlds beyond his own.

entities.name: Drafna
entities.description: Scholar whose wife studied memories of the land.

entities.name: Hurkyl
entities.description: Scholar and wife of Drafna, who meditates on Lat-Nam.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: Discoverer whose work draws on memories of the land.

entities.name: Oryan
entities.description: Urzan artificer who recreated a Thran portal and tested it himself.

entities.name: Queen Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Queen who says her husband can bottle the sky yet ignore its beauty.

entities.name: Bolgon
entities.description: Argivian surveyor who sent a last dispatch about the Sardian dwarves.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian whose collected writings describe the oil consuming hosts.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Child to whom Tawnos wrote about building a flying prototype.

entities.name: Tocasia
entities.description: Archaeologist whose journal records hopes the brothers will work together.

entities.name: Jarsyl
entities.description: Diarist with an heirloom from Phyrexia.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: Journal writer who describes revokers created to hunt dissent.

entities.name: Rayne
entities.description: Researcher on powerstones and storing matter as energy.

entities.name: Willa
entities.description: Yotian artificer who keeps development logs.

entities.name: Gamelen
entities.description: Citanul elder.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Builder of angels from the spirits of fallen warriors.

entities.name: Terisia
entities.description: White-stone-ringed city of scholarship.

entities.name: Lat-Nam
entities.description: Place Hurkyl meditates on.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Place whose resources Gix hopes to keep from Urza.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane of grease-stained wastes where an heirloom was forged.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane whose hedrons Ugin arranged to direct leylines.

entities.name: Sardian dwarves
entities.description: Dwarves who let superstition override common sense per Bolgon.

entities.name: Powerstone
entities.description: Energy stored in material form, used in devices.

events.summary: Oona bottles the sky one night and releases it the next after aligning the stars.
events.quote: One night Oona bottled the sky.

events.summary: Ugin arranges the hedrons of Zendikar to direct leylines.
events.quote: The spirit dragon Ugin arranged the hedrons of Zendikar to direct leylines of energy.

events.summary: Oryan recreates a Thran portal and decides to test it himself before telling Urza.
events.quote: "I have re-created a Thran portal at last!

events.summary: Ashnod reports a breakthrough in liquimetal coating on the fifth iteration.
events.quote: "We've had a breakthrough on the fifth iteration.

events.summary: Gix tells an agent to give the schematic to the younger brother to keep Argoth's resources from Urza.
events.quote: "Give the schematic to the younger brother.

events.summary: Urza turns his focus from the Thran to worlds beyond his own, seeking a way to break the Phyrexian scourge.
events.quote: Urza turned his focus from the Thran to worlds beyond his own

relations.note: Drafna calls the researcher his wife
relations.quote: the same 'memories of the land' my wife studied
"My husband is clever enough to bottle the sky, and foolish enough to ignore its beauty."
